issues.description: Element: output columns for Aufgabe 01 (SQL query). Problem statement (problem_statement.md line 18) requires exactly these columns: Zoo.name, Zoo.url, Gemeinde.name, and Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk. The template (template_repository/aufgabe01.sql lines 1-2) provides a starting query selecting Zoo.name and Gemeinde.name but lacks Zoo.url, Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk and a join condition. The solution (solution_repository/aufgabe01.sql lines 1-3) uses SELECT Zoo.*, Gemeinde.* and a join, which returns all columns from both tables rather than the four specifically required. This mismatch between the required column set and the solution's returned columns is confusing for students and can cause automated checks to fail because the solution exposes extra columns and the template omits required columns.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution (and optionally the template) to select exactly the required columns and include the join condition. For example: SELECT Zoo.name, Zoo.url, Gemeinde.name AS gemeinde_name, Gemeinde.regierungsbezirk FROM Zoo JOIN Gemeinde ON Zoo.gemeindeschluessel = Gemeinde.schluessel; Update the template to include the same selected columns (or a correct starter that includes Zoo.url and the join) so template, problem statement, and solution agree on the expected output schema.
